outcome: Infants born small for gestational age (SGA)
cohort: 103 women with SLE who gave birth at the Karolinska University Hospital between 2000 and 2017.
finding: Lupus nephritis was found to be a significant risk factor for adverse obstetric outcomes in women with SLE, particularly preeclampsia, which was associated with premature birth and caesarean section.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was associated with pre-eclampsia in women with lupus nephritis.
birth_weight: Infants born small for gestational age (SGA) were analyzed as an outcome.
